description: Sets the offer price (net PLN) of a tender in 'Moje przetargi' — the same as choosing the price in Przetargowy Janusz: one of Janusz's price variants (aggressive, realistic, higher — listed in get_my_tender fill_details.price_proposals) or variant 'manual' with amount. The price goes into the offer documents; it is the price the user states or picks. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.
name: confirm_bid_price
title: Zatwierdź cenę oferty
